Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Yastika Bhatia and Shafali Verma to open the batting for India Women. Jess Kerr to start with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! India Women need 156 runs from 20 overs to win the one-off T20I. New Zealand Women have a good bowling attack and this promises to be an interesting chase. Do join us for the second essay which begins shortly.

India Women started really well with the ball and it was Pooja Vastrakar who set the tone upfront. She kept things tight and didn't let Devine and Bates free their arms. The spinners also bowled well and kept the White Ferns' batters on their toes. Rajeshwari Gayakwad got the prized scalp of Suzie Bates while Deepti Sharma snared a couple of wickets. Simran Bahadur conceded some extra runs but the pick of the bowler was Pooja Vastrakar who finished with figures of 4-1-16-2.

Sophie Devine and Suzie Bates started steadily with the bat and it was the skipper Devine who started scoring freely once she got her eye in. Although, she perished soon after and Bates never really got going after that. Maddy Green and Amelia Kerr then played handy knocks but it was the cameo of Lea Tahuhu in the end overs which took New Zealand Women to a competitive total, which could also prove to be a match-winning one.

A good recovery in the end by New Zealand Women and they have managed to post a very competitive total on the board. India Women would be a tad disappointed as they did leak some runs in the end overs. Although, it was still a decent bowling performance from them.
A single to end but a really good over for the hosts! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped to cover for one. New Zealand Women end with 155/5.
FOUR! And again! Lovely batting! Once again she moves right across, almost close to the wide line on the off side. This is bowled well wide too but Martin whips it over square leg for a boundary.

FOUR! That is outstanding batting! There was no one behind square on the leg side. Martin just walks across, Yadav bowls it slower and outside off, Martin sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. 150 up.
Just the one! On off, this is hit down to long off for only one this time.
Brilliant running! On off, this is lofted down to long off. There was only one in there but Martin, touches and then turns, goes for the second and completes it.
Nicely played! On off, this is lofted wide of long off for two.

Lands safe! Shorter and on the body, Brooke Halliday looks to pull, this goes off the top edge but lands safe on the leg side. One taken. A really good spell from Pooja Vastrakar comes to an end. 4-1-16-2 for her.
A dot! Outside off, this is guided to point.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a very good catch and Tahuhu walks back but she has done her job. A really fine cameo from her. Provided the much-needed impetus. On middle, Tahuhu looks to go over long on. Does not time it that well. Shafali Verma takes a good catch. Katey Martin walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Raining boundaries off the bat of Tahuhu! Shorter and down the leg side, Tahuhu swings, it goes fine on the leg side for a boundary.
FOUR! Smack! Hit with disdain! Shorter and on off, this is flat-batted over the mid off fielder and into the fence. Another boundary for Tahuhu.
Good running! On middle, this is nudged towards mid-wicket for one.
A dot to end an action-packed over! On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries and Tahuhu is playing a gem of a knock! Sharma bowls it slower and wider outside off, she wants Tahuhu to drag, Tahuhu does so and really well, wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Hit hard and to the fence! Not what India would have wanted after the wicket. On the pads, Tahuhu sweeps it wide of short fine leg and into the fence.

OUT! TAKEN! India continue to pick wickets at regular intervals! This is fired outside off, Green shuffles across and looks to heave it, this goes off the top edge and Poonam at short fine leg, takes a good catch. Brooke Halliday walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Poonam Yadav b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads, Lea Tahuhu looks to sweep but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side for one. Leg bye.
On middle, this is hit through square leg for one.
SIX! Over the fence! That has been nailed and the last ball spoils the over. Tahuhu steps out, she does not quite get close to the pitch of the ball but still drags it well over the long on fence.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Another loud appeal from the keeper but nothing! Outside off, Green looks to sweep, extra bounce on this one. She misses.
Singles won't harm India! On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Dot! Dots are gold! Slower and outside off, Tahuhu looks to drag it but misses.
On the bounce! Green comes down the track, she does not time it that well, she chips it down towards long on, it goes on the bounce for one.
Just the 6 from this one by Deepti Sharma! On the pads, this is hit through square leg for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
How has that missed the off pole? Flatter and around off, Tahuhu looks to heave it on the leg side but misses. It goes just past the off pole.
Green misses out! This is down the leg side, she sweeps but to short fine leg. Only one again.
On middle, this is hit through mid-wicket for one.
Two! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Up and over! Despite the boundary, a superb over, a wicket and just the four from it. Fuller and on off, this is lofted over mid off for a boundary.
Make that five in a row! Shorter and outside off, this is guided to point.

OUT! TAKEN! What an over this is turning out to be by Pooja Vastrakar! 3 dots before this one and now the wicket of Amelia Kerr! Short and on middle, this one skids through. Amelia Kerr is hurried into the pull, it goes off the splice up in the air and the fielder at cover, Shafali Verma pouches it with ease. Lea Tahuhu walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Make that three in a row! Short now and outside off, Kerr cuts but to point.
Hit hard but for no runs! Two dots in a row! Fuller and on off, Kerr hits it hard but to mid off.
She has hit that on her helmet! Kerr tries to play the ramp shot. The paddle scoop. She though tries to drag it from outside off but ends up getting a top edge which hits her on the helmet.
Two to end and welcome big over for the hosts! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled wide of long on for two.
FOUR! Hard down the gound! Second boundary in the over! Green steps out, she gets to the pitch of it and then hammers it back past the bowler for another boundary.
Should have played that off the front foot! Outside off, Green looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! That is a beautiful shot! Green steps out and makes room, she gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
On middle, this is pulled down to long on for one more.
Slower and on off, this is slapped towards cover for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one. Another decent over for India.

Half an appeal but turned down! THe keeper was very interested there. Outside off, Green looks to play the reverse sweep. There is the sound as the ball passes the bat. Richa Ghosh takes it and appeals but turned down.
On middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket for just a single again.
Just wide! Slows it up and lands it fuller and on off, This is chipped back to the left of the bowler who dives but it evades her. One taken.
Fires this one in and on off, defended.
On the bounce! Kerr comes down the track, does not quite get close to the pitch of the ball. She swings, not off the middle and it goes on the bounce to long on for one.
On middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one more.
Brilliant fielding! On the pads, Green sweeps it through backward square leg. Rana there, makes a lot of ground to her right, dives and stops it.
On off, Kerr pushes it towards cover. The fielder dives to his left and stops it.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.

OUT! TIMBER! Suzie Bates is out of here and now both the openers are back in the hut. Excellent delivery. Bates comes down the track and Gayakwad slows it up and also drags the length back. Bates does not get to the pitch of it, she looks to hit it across the line but misses and it knocks the stumps. Big wicket. India will look to pull things back now. Maddy Green walks out to bat.
Flatter and on middle, Kerr works it through mid-wicket for one.
Very full and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Good stop! On off, this is hit hard to the left of Kerr who dives and stops it.

FOUR! Misfield! Not an easy ball to stop. Sharma needed to be brave. This is swept firmly and in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Deepti there runs in, it lands short of her, she then looks to stop it half heatedly but it goes through for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, Bates hits it hard again but straight to long off for one.
On the bounce! Shorter and on middle, Kerr pulls it hard but on the bounce to deep square leg for one.
That is firmly hit! On middle, this is whipped powerfully towards deep mid-wicket. Deepti Sharma did well to stop it. Just the one.

DRINKS! New Zealand Women have ensured that they have wickets in hand to tee off at the end. However, India Women wouldn't be too disappointed as they have managed to keep the experienced Suzie Bates in check.
Suzie Bates skips down the track. Deepti Sharma drags her length back, around middle. Bates is cramped for room as she tries to work it to the leg side for a run.
A full toss, around middle and leg. Amelia Kerr drags it wide of long on and settles for a run.
On a length, around middle. Amelia Kerr blocks it to the off side.
Fuller in length, around middle. Suzie Bates drills it to long on for a single.
A full toss, around off. Amelia Kerr whacks it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder and takes two runs.
A half-tracker, around off. Amelia Kerr rocks back and pulls it in front of square for a couple of runs.
Excellent running, yet again! This is darted on the pads. Suzie Bates clips it to the leg side and comes back for the second run.
Floated, around off. Suzie Bates prods and keeps it out.
Flatter ball, around middle. Amelia Kerr tucks it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
A googly, around off. Amelia Kerr hangs back and defends it.
On a length, around middle. Suzie Bates tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Looped up, outside off. Suzie Bates looks to sweep but it goes off the toe end back to the bowler.
Flatter ball, around middle. Suzie Bates works it through the mid-wicket region and takes a single.
Amelia Kerr walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Deepti Sharma gets the breakthough! This was tossed up, around middle. Sophie Devine gets down on her knee and looks to slog sweep but it goes off the top edge, high in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Sneh Rana there, settles under it and takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Sneh Rana b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Another full toss, around middle. Suzie Bates works it to the leg side for a single.
Good running! Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Suzie Bates nudges it to the leg side and collects a couple of runs.
A full toss, around off. Sophie Devine sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
BEATEN! Flatter ball, on a length, just outside off. Sophie Devine looks to block but the ball beats her outside edge.
Deepti Sharma comes to bowl.
Flatter ball, on middle and leg. Suzie Bates sweeps it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder. She does well to come back for the second run.
Flatter ball, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it towards sweeper cover and settles for a single.
On a length, around middle. Suzie Bates gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
An overpitched ball, around leg. Suzie Bates looks to heave it away but it goes off the inside edge past the leg stump and the batters sneak in a couple of runs.
Looped up, fuller in length, outside off. Sophie Devine drives it wide of the long off fielder and takes a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Sophie Devine prods and defends it out.
FOUR! A short ball, around middle. Suzie Bates rocks back and pulls it through the vacant square leg region for a boundary. New Zealand Women are 49/0 at the end of the Powerplay.
Tossed up, around middle. Suzie Bates sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket but the fielder in the deep does well to keep it to just two.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Suzie Bates nudges it to the leg side and comes back for the second run.
Floated, fuller in length, outside off. Suzie Bates drags it towards the fielder at extra cover.
Loopy ball, outside off. Suzie Bates shuffles across and scoops it past the short fine leg fielder. Two runs taken.
Tossed up, around middle. Suzie Bates chips it over the mid-wicket fielder and takes a couple.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Sophie Devine presses forward and drives it wide of the cover fielder. The batters collect a couple of runs. Good over for New Zealand Women!
On a length, around middle. Suzie Bates tucks it towards mid-wicket and hands the strike back to Sophie Devine.
Short of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts hard but straight to the fielder at deep point. A single taken.
SIX! BANG! Devine is on a roll! Full ball, around middle and leg. Sophie Devine prods and whips it over the deep square leg region for a massive biggie.
SIX! Even better from Devine! Bahadur goes fuller this time. Sophie Devine lofts it over the long on region for a biggie.
FOUR! WHACKED! Back of a length, around off. Sophie Devine flat-bats it past the fielder at mid on and bags a boundary.
Change of ends for Simran Bahadur.
Darted on the pads. Sophie Devine tucks it behind square on the leg side and takes a single.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! A short ball, outside off. Sophie Devine rocks back and cuts hard. The ball races away to the fence. Top shot from the skipper!
Looped up, around middle and leg. Sophie Devine sweeps hard. The fielder at square leg fumbles and the batters take two runs.
Tossed up, around off. Sophie Devine prods and works it towards backward point.
Just a tad short, around middle. Suzie Bates rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter ball, on off. Suzie Bates cuts it towards cover.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes to bowl now.
Slightly shorter in length, around off. Sophie Devine punches it towards cover.
Fuller in length, outside off. Sophie Devine drives but straight to the fielder at extra cover.
Good-length ball, jagging back in from off. Sophie Devine defends it back to the bowler.
Leg bye! On a length, nipping back in from middle. Suzie Bates misses his flick and gets hit on her pad. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
Good-length ball, around off. Suzie Bates covers the line of the ball and blocks it to the off side.
Short of a length, outside off. Suzie Bates looks to cut but she misses.
Full ball, around off. Suzie Bates leans and drives it towards mid off. She scampers through to the other end.
FOUR! Suzie Bates breaks the shackles! This was a length ball, around middle. Suzie Bates shimmies down and lofts it over the mid on fielder and the ball races away to the fence.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, angling in late from outside off. Suzie Bates looks to block but she misses and the ball goes just past the off pole.
Fuller in length, around off. Suzie Bates skips down and pushes it towards mid off.
On a length, around middle. Sophie Devine tucks it to the leg side for a single.
DROPPED! This was a low full toss, around off. Sophie Devine chips it straight back to the bowler but Simran Bahadur fails to grab it. This could prove to be costly.
Simran Bahadur to bowl from the other end.
Good-length ball, around middle. Sophie Devine taps it to the off side and takes off for a single. Just 2 runs off the first over.
Back of a length, around middle. Sophie Devine stays back and turns it to mid-wicket.
On a length, around off. Sophie Devine keeps it out watchfully.
A length ball, drifting down leg. Suzie Bates tickles it towards fine leg and manages only a single. New Zealand Women and Suzie Bates are up and running!
Good-length ball, just outside off. Suzie Bates hangs back and dabs it onto the deck with soft hands.
Back of a length, around off. Suzie Bates blocks it to covers.

We are done with all the pre-match formalities and it is time for live action. India Women are in a huddle before they spread out in the field. Suzie Bates and Sophie Devine to open the batting for New Zealand Women. Pooja Vastrakar to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
The players of both teams have lined up for their respective national anthems. First, it will be India Women's anthem, followed by New Zealand Women's anthem.

India Women (Playing XI) - Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK), Shafali Verma, Yastika Bhatia, Sabbhineni Meghana, Pooja Vastrakar, Sneh Rana, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Simran Bahadur, Poonam Yadav.
New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Sophie Devine (C), Suzie Bates, Amelia Kerr, Maddy Green, Brooke Halliday, Katey Martin (WK), Lauren Down, Hayley Jensen, Lea Tahuhu, Jess Kerr, Hannah Rowe.
TOSS - India Women have won the toss and they have elected to field first.

Hello and welcome to the one-off T20I between India Women and New Zealand Women. With the World Cup nearing both the teams will take this series as an opportunity to prepare for the grand tournament. Saying that, both would be eager to win. This promises to be an exciting clash.
... MATCH DAY ...
